subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron classification be modeled as freeform job tags, typed purpose/display metadata, or a plugin-owned classification seam?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested capability, but the durable API shape affects persisted cron state, Gateway protocol, CLI/UI filters, reminders, and plugin scheduling behavior, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
options.body: Add a durable typed classifier/display contract that can support reminders and broader cron organization without relying on name prefixes or payload parsing.

options.title: Freeform tags
options.body: Implement the reporter's tags array directly and accept user-defined taxonomy as the primary cron organization API.

options.title: Reminder-first classification
options.body: Limit the initial contract to reminder/non-reminder separation and defer general tags/categories to a later design.

recommendation.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a durable typed classifier/display contract that can support reminders and broader cron organization without relying on name prefixes or payload parsing.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the clearest prior API/protocol design call on the closed cron metadata PR.
